messages:
Aisha (CSE): Hi team — quick pulse on NewLeaf private/VPC setup after today's dry run. Found a couple of gaps we should triage before week1 cutover.
Sam (Solutions Eng): thanks — list them out pls, we can address in the 11:30 sync.
Raj (NetOps - Veridian): the biggest blocker for us is outbound egress rules. The current firewall only allows 443 to a subset of IPs; Redwood needs access to the metrics and controlplane endpoints in eu-west-1. Can we get the exact CIDR list?
Aisha (CSE): copying the minimal egress set here: `35.178.0.0/16, 35.156.0.0/16, 34.240.0.0/16` and HTTPS to `api.redwood.example.com`. We'll follow up with a signed tunnel IP list if Dedicated routing changes.
Jenna (Cloud Sec - Veridian): KMS policy question: our security team requires all CMK admin ops to be limited to our admins. How does key creation and rotation work when Redwood is deploying the control plane?
Sam (Solutions Eng): for Private we recommend Customer-managed CMK with cross-account grants. Redwood only needs Encrypt/Decrypt and GenerateDataKey permissions scoped to the service principal. We can share a CFN snippet — quick example below.
Sam (Solutions Eng): ```yaml
Type: AWS::KMS::Key
Properties:
  Description: "NewLeaf Redwood Private CMK"
  KeyPolicy: |
    { /* truncated: allow Veridian admin full access, allow redwood-service principal Encrypt/Decrypt */ }
```
Raj (NetOps - Veridian): that helps. Also noticed audit logs are set to 7 days in our current S3 lifecycle; compliance wants 90 days immutable. Is there a Redwood requirement?
Aisha (CSE): Redwood recommends 30 days by default for dev, but for Private we can support customer policy. We will enable immutable writes if you set the bucket retention policy. We'll update the runbook steps in the handoff doc.
Jenna (Cloud Sec - Veridian): one more: IAM role used by inference nodes is currently using wildcard S3 access in the PoC. Need least-privilege policy before GA.
Aisha (CSE): agreed — Sam will produce scoped policies for model artifacts and logs. Sam, can you attach those before EOD?
Sam (Solutions Eng): yes, I'll post the role policy and a terraform snippet in the 11:30 follow-up.
Aisha (CSE): renewal/health note — account flagged as "at-risk" in CRM due to timeline slip and compliance asks. If we don't resolve KMS+audit retention by next Friday, they may pause Dedicated contract. Let's treat this as high priority.
Raj (NetOps - Veridian): understood — we'll prioritise. Can we get a one-pager with the exact changes and expected MTTD/MTTR improvements?
Aisha (CSE): will do. I'll draft a short remediation playbook and share in #customer-success and the week1 runbook.
deploy-bot: Deployment check reported: controlplane-v1.4 dry-run completed with warnings: 2 (network egress), 1 (kms-policy-scope). See: https://deploys.redwood.internal/ctrlplane/9876
Sam (Solutions Eng): noted warnings — I'll address kms-policy-scope first.
Jenna (Cloud Sec - Veridian): thanks. Can we have a 30-min deep-dive tomorrow at 09:00 UTC to walk the policy snippets with our security team?
Aisha (CSE): scheduled 09:00 UTC tomorrow — meeting invite sent. Agenda: egress CIDRs, CMK key policy, S3 retention + immutability, least-privilege IAM role.
Raj (NetOps - Veridian): thanks all. Quick ask: pls include a short checklist we can give our SRE to mark items as done during cutover.
Aisha (CSE): will include checklist with exact commands and terraform changes. Attaching ticket for tracking: CS-4567. We'll update status after the deep-dive. :thumbsup:
